target.title: fix(infra): add NaN guard for date parse in session cost usage
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`sessions.usage.logs` directly parsed top-level transcript timestamps. An invalid timestamp produced `NaN`, which became `null` at the Gateway JSON boundary instead of the endpoint's numeric timestamp contract.

Closes #99413.

## Why This Change Was Made

The maintainer fixup routes detail logs through the module's existing `parseTimestamp` owner instead of adding a second post-hoc finite-number guard. This gives detail logs and usage summaries one canonical rule:

- valid top-level timestamps keep their epoch-millisecond value;
- invalid top-level timestamps can use the finite nested message timestamp;
- entries without any valid timestamp use numeric `0`.

The refactor removes duplicate parsing logic and adds an inline note at the JSON-sensitive boundary.

## User Impact

Session usage log timestamps remain finite JSON numbers even when a transcript contains malformed metadata. Valid transcripts are unchanged, and a usable nested timestamp is no longer discarded.

## Evidence

Exact prepared head: `484e1f32c928f2246f2b6c9d00ed760a3e0ff036`.

- Native `scripts/pr` exact-head hosted gates passed: [CI run 28770108392](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28770108392).
- Fresh final-head AutoReview: no accepted/actionable findings.
- Regression coverage exercises malformed/no-fallback → `0`, malformed/finite nested fallback → nested epoch milliseconds, and valid ISO → unchanged epoch milliseconds.
- Source-blind sanitized-AWS Gateway validation passed on lease `cbx_1e6bd425c785` (`blue-crab`), public networking, no Tailscale, no hydration, and `CI` as the only allowed environment variable: [run `run_ff47f44bb6d0`](https://crabbox.openclaw.ai/portal/runs/run_ff47f44bb6d0).
- The source-blind run called the real Gateway `sessions.usage.logs` path without inspecting the implementation. It observed `[0, 1700000000123, 1704164645000]`, all finite JSON numbers with no `null`; repeat output was stable; valid-ISO and removed-nested-fallback mutations produced the expected values; a missing session returned no fabricated logs.
- `git diff --check` passed.

No live provider call was needed; this is local transcript parsing exposed through the running Gateway RPC.

AI-assisted: implementation review, fixup, and validation used AI assistance; all cited commands, SHAs, and run identifiers are real.
